visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a white textured knit cardigan, speaks energetically to the camera in a room with a framed picture and a green plant in the background. (2) A split screen displays the woman's face, comparing skin texture on the left and right sides. (3) The woman gestures near her face while speaking; pink and yellow variety text boxes appear at the bottom. (4) A close-up of a face with red, irritated skin is shown, with white arrows pointing to the forehead, cheeks, and chin. (5) Back to the woman, she places her hands on her cheeks, conveying a worried or shocked expression. (6) An extreme close-up of skin highlights enlarged pores and texture within dotted circles. (7) A close-up of a dry cheek area shows fine lines being traced by a white animated outline. (8) Three skincare products (a jar, a bottle, and a box) are displayed on a wooden tray with a small white flower. (9) A clear, thick liquid is dispensed from a dropper onto the woman's hand, which is then applied to her face, leaving it looking wet and glossy. (10) A graphic background displays photos of doctors and a timeline of the brand's history with Traditional Chinese text. (11) The woman, wearing a white headband and robe, massages the essence into her face using upward strokes. (12) A step-by-step tutorial sequence begins, showing the woman performing various facial massage techniques, with arrows indicating the direction of movement. (13) A cream product is shown in its jar on a tray next to donuts; the woman then applies white cream to her face in a 'T' and 'U' pattern. (14) The woman massages the cream into her face and neck in a brightly lit bathroom environment. (15) Close-up shots of her face show text labels for skin concerns like 'Dull' and 'Sagging' being addressed. (16) A side-by-side comparison of the woman's face on 'Day 1' versus 'Day 7' shows a significant improvement in radiance and smoothness. (17) A screen capture of the Watsons website shows the product listing. (18) The woman holds the two featured products, smiling and gesturing for the viewers to comment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone over a bouncy, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM. A bright 'ding' sound effect punctuates the introduction. (2) Frequent 'whoosh' transition sound effects occur as the speaker's intensity increases while describing skin problems. The electronic beat remains consistent and driving. (3) A series of soft 'pop' and 'click' sound effects accompany the display of brand logos and product features. The BGM texture becomes slightly more layered with synthetic pads. (4) The speaker adopts a rhythmic, slightly slower delivery for the step-by-step massage tutorial. Each step is marked by a clear 'digital chime' sound. (5) High-frequency 'sparkle' and 'ding' sound effects are used to emphasize skin results and glowing effects. The BGM maintains its upbeat major key tonality. (6) A final 'ding' sound coincides with the brand name appearing as the BGM fades out sharply with the speaker's closing invitation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Evidence -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement and tutorial for JCPROGRAM skincare products. It hooks the audience by showing common post-medical beauty skin issues, introduces the brand as a professional medical solution, demonstrates specific usage through a massage guide, and provides visual proof of results to encourage purchase at Watsons.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator demonstrates the products, explains their benefits in detail, shows results, and mentions specific purchase locations (Watsons).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high production value with professional graphics and a synchronized audio-visual rhythm to build trust in a medical-grade skincare brand.
